events.event_name: The People's Theatre Community Open House & Intergenerational Jazz Power Jam
events.brand: The People's Theatre × Jazz Power Initiative
events.what_it_is: Opening-day celebration for The People's Theatre: Centro Cultural Inmigrante, with performances, workshops, open classes, interactive theatre, backstage tours, family activities and a Jazz Power concert.
events.what_is_free: The open house programming and Jazz Power celebration are free; food and drinks are available for purchase.
events.caveats: The official event page currently says advanced reservations are full. Visitors can join the waiting list and may also come during the open house, but waiting-list guests are admitted only as space becomes available and entry is explicitly not guaranteed. Do not present this as an open Free RSVP.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19. Open House 2–5 PM; Jazz Power concert follows at 5 PM. Official address: 419 West 206th Street. Advanced reservations are full; join the waitlist. Same-day admission is capacity-dependent and not guaranteed.

occurrences.hours: 2 PM–5 PM open house; concert at 5 PM
